The '''2018–19 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas at Little Rock]] during the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Trojans, led by first-year head coach [[Darrell Walker]], played their home games at the [[Jack Stephens Center]] in [[Little Rock, Arkansas]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 10–21, 5–13 in Sun Belt play to finish in a tie for last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2019 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]].

==Previous season==
The [[2017–18 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team|Trojans]] finished the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2017–18 season]] 7–25, 4–14 in Sun Belt play to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]] to [[2017–18 Appalachian State Mountaineers men's basketball team|Appalachian State]].

On March 9, 2018, the school fired head coach [[Wes Flanigan]] after just two seasons where he compiled a record of 22–42.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22703788/university-arkansas-little-rock-fires-coach-team-loses-school-record-25-games|title=Arkansas-Little Rock fires Wes Flanigan after team loses school-record 25 games|website=ESPN.com|agency=Associated Press|date=March 9, 2018|accessdate=March 9, 2018}}</ref> On March 29, the school hired former [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] player [[Darrell Walker]] who had spent the last two seasons as head coach of [[NCAA Division II|Division II]] [[Clark Atlanta Panthers|Clark Atlanta University]].<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.arkansasonline.com/news/2018/mar/28/ualr-makes-walker-hire-official-2018032/|title=UALR hires former Razorback Darrell Walker as next men's basketball coach|newspaper=[[Arkansas Democrat-Gazette]]|first=Brooks|last=Kubena|date=March 28, 2018|accessdate=March 29, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/ncaab/2018/03/27/arkansas-little-rock-hires-walker-as-its-new-coach/33329969/|title=Arkansas-Little Rock hires Walker as its new coach|work=USA TODAY|access-date=2018-04-06|language=en}}</ref>
